Extending the same moral to every chaotic system, including ones Wolfram thinks generate randomness intrinsically, requires a decomposition of randomness that the simulations do not force. operationalization: Simulate one-dimensional continuous cellular automata, including fractional part of 3/2 times the neighborhood average and addition of a constant modulo 1, in exact rational or high-precision arithmetic.
